gloss: to catch the eye; to attract attention

definitions.gloss: to catch the eye; to stand out; to draw attention
definitions.explanation: Said of something whose appearance makes people look at it — a bright color, an unusual design, a striking headline. The thing that stands out is the subject; the person who notices takes の or は when mentioned at all.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{目|め}を{引|ひ}く。
examples.english: The red sign catches your eye.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧{目|め}を{引|ひ}いた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧だった。
examples.english: The piece that stood out most at the venue was hers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んだ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦パッケージ→パッケージ：11699_pakkeeji⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目|め}を{引|ひ}いて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Among all the products on the shelf, only that package was catching customers' eyes.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in advertising and design talk: a display, headline, or outfit {目|め}を{引|ひ}く when it succeeds in standing out. The judgment is neutral to positive; drawing unwanted stares is ⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧ or ⟦{人目|ひとめ}→人目：17973_hitome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目|め}を{引|ひ}く: to catch people's attention
- {目|め}を{引|ひ}く⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧: an eye-catching design
- ⟦{一際|ひときわ}→一際：10493_hitokiwa⟧{目|め}を{引|ひ}く: to stand out conspicuously

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧: to be conspicuous — a state, with no implication that anyone is drawn in
- ⟦{目|め}を{奪|うば}う→目を奪う：30638_mewoubau⟧: to be captivating — much stronger, holding the viewer's gaze
